# Maybee Creations

> Creatively Crafted educational discovery world maps and adventure guides for faith, freedom, frontier, farlands, sports fans, and the AI future.

Maybee Creations (https://maybeecreations.com) is a digital creation studio that makes printable fantasy-style cartography paired with adventure guidebooks. Products span six realms: Faith (Soul Explorer Bible maps), Freedom (Liberty Explorer civics maps), Frontier (Frontier Explorer science, literature, music, missionary, and liberty maps), Farlands (Destination Explorer realm of Farlands Explorer country map kits), Fans (Legend Explorer NFL, baseball, college football, and tennis Legend Lands), and Future (Tomorrow Explorer AI learning maps).

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://maybeecreations.com/): Overview of all six realms and downloadable educational maps
- [Faith](https://maybeecreations.com/faith): Soul Explorer Bible book category maps, Life Of character maps, and adventure guides
- [Freedom](https://maybeecreations.com/freedom): Liberty Explorer civics, founding figures, and American history maps
- [Frontier](https://maybeecreations.com/frontier): Frontier Explorer maps of Einstein, the Odyssey, Mozart, Shakespeare, Tesla, and more
- [Farlands](https://maybeecreations.com/farlands): Destination Explorer gallery of 50 Farlands Explorer country kits. Each kit is an illustrated fantasy map, guidebook, and audio tour ($7.77): Argentina, Australia, Austria, Brazil, Cambodia, Canada, China, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, Ethiopia, France, Germany, Greece, Guatemala, Iceland, India, Indonesia, Iran (Persia), Iraq, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Jordan, Kenya, Mali, Mexico, Mongolia, Morocco, Nepal, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Peru, Poland, Portugal, Russia, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Thailand, Turkey, United Kingdom, United States, Uzbekistan, and Vietnam
- [Fans](https://maybeecreations.com/fans): Legend Explorer NFL, baseball, college football, and tennis Legend Lands
- [Future](https://maybeecreations.com/future): Tomorrow Explorer AI realm maps with Adventure Pack tutorials
- [Stories](https://maybeecreations.com/stories): Essays on the history and meaning behind the maps
- [Shop](https://shop.maybeecreations.com): Shopify storefront for Faith, Freedom, Frontier, Farlands, and Future printable map downloads
- [Farlands collection](https://shop.maybeecreations.com/collections/farlands): Shopify Farlands realm collection
- [Fans shop](https://payhip.com/MaybeeCreations): Payhip storefront for Legend Land / Fans maps

## What we make

Educational discovery world maps are printable, fantasy-style maps paired with guidebooks full of prompts, missions, and reflections. They are designed for families, homeschoolers, students, teachers, and curious adults.

## Audience

Families, homeschoolers, K-12 students, civics teachers, science and literature learners, expedition explorers, NFL and baseball fans, and beginners learning AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).
